templates.name: Customer Greeting
templates.template: Hello {{customer.name}}! Welcome back to DeepSeek. {{#if customer.recent_activity}}I see you were recently working on {{customer.recent_activity}}.{{/if}} How can I assist you today?

templates.name: Support Inquiry
templates.template: I understand you need help with {{#if chat_history.last_topic}}{{chat_history.last_topic}}{{else}}something{{/if}}. Let me assist you with that. {{#if customer.support_tickets}}I notice you have {{customer.support_tickets.length}} open support tickets. Would you like me to help with one of those?{{/if}}

templates.name: Billing Question
templates.template: Regarding your billing inquiry, {{#if customer.subscription}}you are currently on the {{customer.subscription.plan}} plan which renews on {{customer.subscription.renewal_date}}.{{else}}I don't see an active subscription for your account.{{/if}} How can I help you with your billing question?
